change_log.summary: Provide SIGN-specialized review synthesis in KnowledgeBase.read
details: Diagnosis: The existing KnowledgeBase.read returned raw stored records but lacked a reviewer-dimension-specific summarization for SIGN reviews. Tests expect a concise SIGN review structure (subdimension claims, scores, and recommendation) synthesized from stored reviewer memories.

Change: Add a SIGN-specific summarizer branch in read() that composes a focused SIGN review (SIGN-BRD, SIGN-DOM, SIGN-SOT, SIGN-IMP), using available stored lessons/facts as evidence and emitting a final numeric score, confidence, key questions, and a recommendation. Keeps previous fallback behavior for other dimensions.

change_log.summary: Add SIGN-dimension specialized review synthesis to KnowledgeBase.read
details: Diagnosis: The SIGN review dimension requires a structured, reviewer-focused synthesis (per traces) but the KnowledgeBase.read returned only generic record listings. This made SIGN queries produce weak, unstructured outputs lacking the specialist-format content.

Change: Implement a SIGN-specific branch in read() that synthesizes a full SIGN review (BRD/DOM/SOT/IMP) from stored reviewer memories, selecting supporting records by keyword heuristics and emitting the requested review fields (paper summary placeholder, per-subcategory opinions, evidence anchors, confidence, actionable suggestions, key questions, and recommendation). Falls back to generic listing for other dimensions.

change_log.summary: Add SIGN-specialist synthesis and focused query handling to KnowledgeBase.read
details: Root cause / diagnosis: The MemoryProgram returned only raw stored memory entries, lacking a dedicated synthesis for SIGN-dimension review requests required by the evaluator protocol. This produced insufficiently structured SIGN reviews and missed summarizing evidence into the expected reviewer template.

Specific change: Implement a SIGN-specialist branch in read() that composes a concise, evidence-backed SIGN review (summary, numeric score/confidence, Opinions per SIGN subcategories with evidence anchors, actionable suggestions, key questions, and recommendation) by selecting and formatting stored records. Preserve existing general behavior for other dimensions.

change_log.summary: Add SIGN-dimension structured review synthesis to KnowledgeBase.read
details: Root cause / diagnosis: The KnowledgeBase.read method returned generic listings for retrieved memories but lacked a specialized, deterministic SIGN-dimension reviewer synthesis. Tests and downstream consumers expect a concise SIGN specialist review (with sub-dimension claims, actionable suggestions, score, confidence, and recommendation) assembled from stored reviewer memories; without this the system produced weaker or inconsistent SIGN outputs.

Specific change: Implement a deterministic SIGN branch in KnowledgeBase.read that selects representative memories for SIGN subcategories (SIGN-BRD, SIGN-DOM, SIGN-SOT, SIGN-IMP), composes a compact structured SIGN review with claims, actionable suggestions, key questions, a numeric score and recommendation, and truncates to the allowed summary length. Preserve the existing fallback behavior for other dimensions.
